description: This file defines the `MenuSessionsInjector` class, responsible for injecting dynamic session, node, usage, and cost information into macOS status menu items within the application. It manages cache refreshes, observes control channel state, and builds complex submenus with custom views for session previews, node info, and usage statistics.

classes.name: MenuSessionsInjector
classes.description: Manages injection and update of session, node, usage, and cost information into macOS status menu. Handles cache management, menu item construction, and asynchronous data refresh.

methods.name: install(into:)
methods.description: Initializes the injector with a given NSStatusItem, preserving existing delegate and starting cache refresh.

methods.name: menuWillOpen(_:)
methods.description: Handles actions needed when menu opens, including injecting dynamic items and starting background cache refresh tasks.

methods.name: menuDidClose(_:)
methods.description: Cleans up when menu closes, cancelling ongoing tasks.

methods.name: confinementRect(for:on:)
methods.description: Delegates rectangle confinement, falls back to default behavior.
